name: host-exec
description: The seam every host-converging module reaches the machine through — one `exec`, substitutable in a test with `withExec`, so an `apply` that shells out can be exercised instead of merely parsed
instructions: The seam every host-converging module reaches the machine through, plus the `withExec` a test wraps an apply in. `host-dir` (and, in the contributing repo, a dozen others) import it as `../host-exec`; `zbc add` brings it along with them, in either mode.
